[];` and then filters calendars against only this first host's externalId. For collective team events where multiple hosts have destination calendars (as shown in handleNewBooking.ts where teamDestinationCalendars are pushed to evt.destinationCalendar), the CalDAV service will only create events on calendars matching the first host's externalId. Secondary hosts' calendars won't match the filter condition, so they'll be filtered out, and the Promise.all will resolve successfully without actually creating events for those hosts.
